# Rule: ABI tag changed

_Canonical rule slug:_ `abi-tag-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A declaration gains, loses, or changes a compiler ABI tag, remangling its symbol so existing binaries no longer resolve it.

## Canonical demonstration

- [case113_abi_tag_changed](../case113_abi_tag_changed.md) — ABI-tag set change ([abi:cxx11] lost on a single symbol) (🔴 BREAKING)
